_comment: Smoke config: no GPU, no tokens. A stub runner plus fake tasks, used to exercise the optimize slot's orchestration, fault tolerance, re-verification and summarization. Point TASKS_DIR at the fake tasks via the environment. The stub runner writes no artifacts by itself: point STUB_SCRIPT at a script that fakes an attempt -- that is what stands in for the agent.

target._note_enforce: Smoke config: stub skills returning fixed values, no serving stack and no real kernels. Any config that does target a real stack must fill in target.model instead.
